entries.query_str: virginia state tax return deadline 2026, is it april 15 like federal
entries.answer: No — Virginia's individual income tax deadline is **May 1** (for calendar-year filers), later than the federal April 15 deadline [1]. If May 1 falls on a weekend, it moves to the next business day. Virginia also grants an **automatic 6-month extension to file** (to November 1), but **not to pay**: at least 90% of the tax owed must be paid by May 1 to avoid an extension penalty [1][2].

entries.query_str: i moved nowhere this year, just one w-2 with VA withholding. any reason not to just use free file
entries.answer: With one W-2 and no other income, Virginia's free e-file options are usually fine [1]. Check eligibility (income limits apply to some free-file partners) and make sure the **Virginia withholding (W-2 Box 17)** is entered correctly so the refund or balance comes out right [1].
